The ABUS Link Station Pro App provides easy and uncomplicated access to selected ABUS products - directly on your mobile phone or tablet. Cameras and recorders are set up in just a few steps using a QR code or by entering the ip address. The app shows recordings and live images from up to 16 cameras.

Functions: 
1. intuitive operating and user interface, e.g. camera arrangement by drag & drop 
2. remote access to live images and recordings via mobile devices
3. live image display of up to 16 cameras in landscape mode
4. push notification when somebody rings the bell 
5. save an instant image/video clip directly from live view 
6. pinch-to-zoom function: stepless digital zoom in camera live image and playback
7. controlling and setting up a zoom camera (PTZ) with the touch screen 
8. controlling switches or relays, e.g. to open a door or operate a light switch 
9. secure connection via encrypted data transfer

REMOTE ACCESS SIMPLE AND CONVENIENT VIA APP 
The app offers remote access to selected ABUS products via WLAN and the mobile Internet. Security cameras can be easily set up and released via QR codes - without complicated configuration via the router. 

IMPROVED USER INTERFACE
The new, intuitive user interface lets you group cameras individually as favorites and create different scenarios. The pinch-to-zoom function enables continuous digital zooming in live images and camera playback. Zoom cameras (PTZ) can also be controlled via the touch screen of the mobile phone or tablet. The app can also control the alarm outputs of security cameras: This makes it possible to operate further switches or relays via the app. In case of events, light switches can be switched on or off and doors can be opened. 

PUSH NOTIFICATIONS
ABUS Link Station Pro notifies all authorized users via push notification when an event occurs: for example, if someone rings or an alarm is triggered. 

DISPATCH BY MAIL
Instant images or video clips can be created directly from the live view or playback function and stored in the local device memory. From there it is possible to continue using the files by e-mail or upload the clips and images.

An FT8 decoder.  FT8 is a weak signal digital mode, currently very popular in the amateur radio HF shortwave bands.  The ft8d app allows decoding FT8 8FSK modulated signals contained in externally provided audio or sound from an SSB radio or SDR.  The app supports Level 1 decoding of messages with standard callsigns or 13 character free text messages.

The app can also generate standard FT8 message audio, so can be used to experiment with sending and receiving FT8 encoded and modulated audio.  The app does NOT perform Auto-sequencing, or encode long hashed callsigns.
